chunks: Then you will be raised up on the Day of Resurrection.
ai.seo_question: What happens to people on the Day of Resurrection according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Mu'minun underscores the certainty of resurrection (Ba'th) as a fundamental tenet of Shia eschatology, linking the physical return to life with the ultimate accountability before Allah. It serves as a reminder that the temporary nature of worldly life culminates in an eternal gathering where deeds are weighed, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl).
